title: Penalty on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance - Fair Practices Code and KYC Violations
description: <cite index="26-2,26-3">RBI imposed a total penalty of Rs. 66.7 lakh on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance for violations related to regulatory compliance.</cite> <cite index="26-4,26-5,26-6,26-7">Bank of Baroda was fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with Fair Practices Code for Lenders and KYC guidelines, with the penalty following a supervisory inspection based on the bank's financial position as of March 31, 2025, where the regulator found the public sector lender had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts.</cite>
